verdict.rationale: VPM's first-party docs say it acts as registered agent, receiving service of process, legal notices, and state correspondence. They say this is 'Included FREE with all virtual mailbox plans' and that served documents are scanned and available online the same day, so it is bundled with the mailbox plan. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration, and details on which states are covered and how service is tied to and alerted within the account.
